notes.title: Tame It Too! Demo Bug Fixes Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/dfa0d650f0d32804b71d59f04a0957c418b42b0c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone!
[/p][p]We received several bug reports after releasing the new demo that were making progress difficult, so we decided to roll out one more small update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/229fedd5ead0bf3cd188f1db11337928c2e9e467.jpg"][/img]The most significant improvement was polishing the scene with the three Tonyas, we greatly enhanced the animations and added sound effects, making the scene even hotter!
[/p][p]We also fixed several critical bugs that were blocking progress for some players, along with a bunch of annoying little quirks.
[/p][p]Wishing you all a fantastic mood and stay tuned so you don’t miss anything exciting![/p][p][/p][h3]Changelog[/h3][list][*][p]Save files can have custom titles now, just add it to the file name after the date with `_` character, like this: manual_20250628-043433_custom title.sav;[/p][/*][*][p]Fix clay walls on north path;[/p][/*][*][p]Fix in Tonya foursome scene;[/p][/*][*][p]Add sfx to Tonya foursome scene;[/p][/*][*][p]Show steles on the map;[/p][/*][*][p]Add hint for fairy escape quest;[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]
